text: When there is no time for sports, the body can be “switched on” through work with the spine and breathing. Stand up, feet hip-width apart. On the exhalation, slowly lower your head and, rounding your back, perform a forward bend. On the inhalation, just as slowly straighten up, expanding the chest (push the pelvis forward, and transfer the arch from the lumbar region into the thoracic section of the spine. Perform 5-10 such bends. And then 5-10 slow squats with deep exhalations and inhalations. These two exercises will literally fill you with vigor and a sense of inner strength in 3-5 minutes.
